title: Horizontal Kakeya maximal operators in finite Heisenberg groups: Exact exponents and applications
summary: Let $q$ be an odd prime power. We study Kakeya maximal operators associated with horizontal lines in the finite Heisenberg groups $\mathbb H_n(\mathbb F_q)$. Our principal object is the refined-direction maximal operator, whose parameter records the projective horizontal direction together with the central homogeneous coordinate determined by horizontality. In rank one, we prove \[ \|M_{\mathbb H_1}^{\mathrm{rd}}F\|_{\ell^2(\mathcal D_1)} \lesssim q^{\frac{1}{2}} \|F\|_{\ell^2(\mathbb H_1(\mathbb F_q))}, \] where the exponent $\frac{1}{2}$ is sharp.
